validation.method: Reviewed test code and real implementation; tests use temporary directories and mocked subprocess/runtime/service calls. Native contracts were separately checked in local pinned Git objects, rather than inferred from handwritten fixtures.

limitations: No live endpoint, API key value, quota, provider behavior or remote embedding response was tested. Frozen:false remains correct until a separate execution decision.
No Docker/Rust binary integration was run; native CLI/auth/manifest/search contracts were verified statically against pinned source.
Known-secret redaction/scans verify injected secret values, not arbitrary encoded variants; no real key values were accessed.
The full repository test suite was not rerun; only 32 relevant offline remote, wrapper and trial-plan tests were run.
MCP retrieval success is operational readiness, not useful evidence, answer quality or causal efficiency benefit.
A single fresh baseline/remote-zg pair cannot isolate an embedding-specific causal effect against historical local runs.
